title: Dirt Armor!
description: This project adds dirt armor to Minecraft.
body:
**WHY IS DIRT ARMOR NOT A THING? WHY CANT YOU JUST GET ARMOR RIGHT AWAY WITHOUT PUNCHING A TREE?**

Well, these are very good questions that this mod right here, yup, this one, no not the yaaaaaaaa mod THIS MOD, answers.

Dirt Armor Stats:
- Durability:5
- Damage Values:2
- Enchantibility:5
- Toughness:0
- KBresistance:0
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Hope you like it and share it with your friends.
                                           --
(Note that there is a GUI that opens when you join a world. You can ignore that. It is explaining that my artistic skills are just WRONG.)
